title: Produce blind candidate B with personal:operator across four surfaces
description: Use the revised skill and frozen fixture to create variant-b artifacts: inspectable responsive HTML covering personal landing, dashboard and case-study/report plus a real 5-slide executive decision-memo PPTX. Also capture the same skill without personal:operator as negative control. Record prompt, skill hash, token/profile activation, screenshots/renders, QA and accessibility evidence. Acceptance: all hard gates in contract pass; all slides render and slides_test reports no overflow; narrow/wide HTML render without clipping; semantic categories remain legible with labels/non-color encoding.

notes.note: DECISION: Controlled personal:operator calibration. Build three exact-copy responsive HTML surfaces plus one real 5-slide 16:9 decision memo, six flagged HTML captures, five full-size slide renders, and an unflagged same-input brand-neutral HTML control. Validate deterministically with nonzero assertions, browser geometry checks, slides_test, and visual inspection.

DECISION: Preserve B as the human-confirmed personal:operator aesthetic. Complete only deterministic QA, correct the false 50KB PPTX plausibility threshold, and document remaining visual-capture evidence without changing approved surfaces.

OPEN-QUESTION: 159/167 assertions pass; the valid five-slide PPTX is ZIP-clean and slides_test reports no overflow. All eight failures are exactly the required flagged/no-flag responsive screenshots, which are absent. Mario's human verdict identifies B as his personal aesthetic. Browser policy blocks agent capture of local file:// pages; no placeholders were fabricated.
